manage.title: Manage booking
manage.description: Review booking details, reschedule, or cancel.
manage.heldNote: The slot is tentatively held. Please wait until confirmation completes.
manage.confirmingNote: Your booking is being confirmed. Refreshing shows the same state.
manage.cancelingNote: Cancellation was requested. Wait for the calendar operation to finish.
manage.unknownNote: The calendar outcome could not be verified. Do not re-request — check the status again shortly.
manage.failedNote: The booking could not be confirmed. No booking was made.
manage.canceledNote: It's been removed from the calendar. Reach out any time if you'd like to meet.
manage.expiredNote: The tentative hold expired, so no booking was made.
manage.confirmedNote: See you then! Use the buttons below if you need to reschedule or cancel.
manage.rescheduleDescription: Your current booking stays in place until the change is confirmed.
manage.rescheduleDone: Change requested. The status updates once confirmed.
manage.cancelDescription: The booking is cancelled when the cancellation request finishes processing.
manage.versionConflict: The booking changed. Loading the latest state.
manage.errorSlotGone: That time is already taken. Pick another.
manage.errorGeneric: Could not process the request. Try again.
